hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ "$(basename "$f")" = ".env" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: direct writes to .env are disabled in this project to protect secrets (RESEND_API_KEY, Sanity project id/dataset). Edit it manually if this is intentional."}}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npx eslint "$f" 2>&1 | head -c 3000); if [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("eslint results for changed file:\n" + $out)}}'; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *src/sanity/schemas/*.ts|*studio/schemaTypes/*.ts) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Reminder: src/sanity/schemas/*.ts and studio/schemaTypes/*.ts are independent copies of the same schema (not shared by import) and must be kept in sync manually. Diff the twin file for this change before finishing."}}' ;; esac; }
